facts.fact: Devan did not see Vellan turn: the bend in the west stair hid the change, so Devan is not Vellan's witness and the word is only a word to him. He infers a bear from the claw marks.
facts.why: needed because it keeps the witness rule intact and sets up the bible's later page-holding beat for Vellan.

facts.fact: Vellan's blade cuts Devan across the left ribs, with a blackbark-gall poison that spreads as a black thread from the wound. The physician Eravi gives it about three days.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires a poison with a deadline and the physician naming it.

facts.fact: Raiu dies on the west stair from four claw furrows across his chest. His death is permanent.
facts.why: needed because the beat calls for Raiu's death.

facts.fact: Neela skipped resin on the new-moon night to stay human and guard Devan, and three of her nails have split to the quick, so the ache has started.
facts.why: needed because the beat says she arrives human, and the ache is the cost.

facts.fact: Neela saddles a grey mare in the fort stable. She tells Muthu to bring Devan after her if she is not back by the second dusk.
facts.why: needed to stage the stable scene and match chapter 26's opening orders.

facts.fact: The antidote is made by Chathu himself and kept in a locked cupboard in the tapping shed at the Resin House. Neela can open the lock.
facts.why: needed because the beat says the only antidote is at the Resin House, and chapter 26 has her take it from the tapping-shed cupboard.
